content.cast.under-the-rams.eurylochus.0.bark.0: 把毛攥死了,船长,当心角。这个钟点顾不上体面。
content.cast.under-the-rams.eurylochus.0.bark.1: 我出过比这更馊的主意。眼下一时想不起是哪回。
content.cast.under-the-rams.eurylochus.0.bark.2: 石头一挪开,你就看沙子。看着沙子,心里也只想沙子。
content.class.odysseus.blurb: 伊萨卡的王,在特洛伊城下耗了十年,至今没能回家。木马是你出的主意。凡是能靠别的法子赢下来的仗,你从来没有真打过——这是你的运气,因为这座洞里的事,没有一件是打得赢的。一把你多半拔不出来的短剑,几支挡一挡黑暗的松明,还有那位灰眼睛的女神在你肩后看着。马戎的烈酒就在底舱,时候到了,弟兄们会替你搬上来。在这座岛上,你没有第二个身份可选——这船人是你的,你把他们劝进去的事,也是你的。

content.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.0.label: 守住这点光。
content.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.0.tooltip: 就在这儿歇着。替我们守住这点光。
content.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.1.label: 那张床。
content.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.text: 要是都一样,船长,就搁这儿吧——我这两个膝盖今天到头了。(他伸一根指头点着栏)羔子、当年的、成年的。三个栏,分得清清楚楚。看着这群羊的是个正经牧人。要是他个头也正经,我心里能舒坦不少。
content.dlg.antiphos.boy.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.antiphos.boy.text: 埃尔佩诺尔啊。行。这趟完事之前,他准得干出点又勇敢又蠢的事——他那号人向来这样。所以才是他守火、我扛袋子:咱俩总得有一个空出两只手,好把另一个拖回家。
content.dlg.antiphos.hold-light.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.antiphos.hold-light.text: 守光。这我干得了。——里头当心,船长。佩里墨得斯那小子要是嗓门起来了,把他撵回我这儿;让他待在能喘气的地方,还顶点用。
content.dlg.antiphos.rest.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.antiphos.rest.text: 歇?这词儿真新鲜。——等我们离了这块礁石我再歇,船长,早一个钟头都不行。在那之前,你干你最拿手的:把咱们想出去。要扛的,我来扛。
content.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.0.label: 这种岛你见过?
content.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.1.label: 看着那小子。
content.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.2.label: 能歇就歇会儿吧,老兄。
content.dlg.antiphos.root.text: 同一根桨,划了九年,船长。它就教会我一件事:大海不恨你——它压根不知道你在。这岛上叫我不踏实的每样东西,不踏实就不踏实在:它可能知道。
content.dlg.antiphos.seen.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.antiphos.seen.text: 见得够多了。好岛上有炊烟,有狗叫,还有人下到水边来看看你是谁。这座岛有烟,没狗,也没人。山上那东西从来没为'谁来了'操过一次心——我很想知道它凭什么。
content.dlg.antiphos.the-size.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.antiphos.the-size.text: 看见了。从看见起我就一直在使劲当没看见。——船长,这条船上我埋过十一个人,从来没有一回是我开口说往回走的。这回我也不说。我只是告诉你,我发觉我想说了。
content.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.opt.0.label: 我说过吧。
content.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.opt.1.label: 浇了火,走。
content.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.text: 这是——等等。等等,你们全回来了。——船长,我都想好词儿了,我把'没能全回来'那套话从头到尾想好了,现在只能揣着它傻站在这儿。——谁来接我一个袋子,趁我还没说出什么蠢话。
content.dlg.elpenor.didnt-come-down.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.didnt-come-down.text: 哦。——哦。好。好吧。——头一年我扛不动,袋子一直是他替我扛的,我一句谢也没说过。我就那么让他扛着。——给我一支桨,船长。我得让手上有点事做。
content.dlg.elpenor.douse-it.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.douse-it.text: 浇了。好。——它一次都没灭过,船长,一次都没有。我知道这种事没人会记着。我会记着。
content.dlg.elpenor.get-aboard.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.get-aboard.text: 上船。好。——你回来了。你说过不落下任何人,你真回来了;而我大约四个钟头前就不信这话了。这一条我要说明白,我要当着面为这个道歉。
content.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.0.label: 守着火堆。
content.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.1.label: 为什么出海,小子?
content.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.1.tooltip: 小子,你当初为什么出海?
content.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.2.label: 我向你保证。
content.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.2.tooltip: 谁也不会被丢下。我说话算话。
content.dlg.elpenor.root.text: 洞里的事是真的吗,船长?告诉我不是真的。——算了,别说了,我看你脸色就知道了。没事。没事!我没事。我上船是来见世面的,这就是世面呗,那,哈,那就这样吧。……山上……你不会把我一个人丢下吧?
content.dlg.elpenor.stay.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.stay.text: 守着火。对。守火我在行——我会看火,我不是废物。我怕的是火光外头那片黑,那个洞整个儿就是那片黑。……我给你守着火,船长。你回来的时候,它一定还烧着。这是我的活儿。这个我干得了。
content.dlg.elpenor.the-fire-held.opt.0.label: 他没能下来。
content.dlg.elpenor.the-fire-held.opt.1.label: 上船,小子。
content.dlg.elpenor.the-fire-held.text: 船长!——船长,你、你真的——你看,你看,火一直没灭,一整夜,一次都没灭。——安提福斯呢。……安提福斯人呢,船长。
content.dlg.elpenor.told-you.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.told-you.text: 你说过。你的确说过。——我打算为这事得意上一个礼拜,先跟你打个招呼。我娘说海先带走最嫩的那个,结果海一个也没带走;照我说,我娘欠我一封信。
content.dlg.elpenor.why.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.why.text: 为了别一辈子当小农庄里最小的儿子呗,船长。我娘不让我出海——她说海先带走最嫩的那个。我当时还笑她。……你要问的话:现在我笑不出来了。可我宁可在这儿害怕,也不要在家里什么都不是。
content.dlg.elpenor.word.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.elpenor.word.text: 你说话算话。——好。那就好。伊萨卡的奥德修斯说了谁也不丢下,这话在我手里就跟一根缆绳一样牢。我记住你这句话了,船长;在你兑现之前,我自己也会撑住。去吧。去把你的聪明使出来。我们就在这儿。
content.dlg.eurylochus.antiphos-gone.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.antiphos-gone.text: 嗯。安提福斯。——他在我后一排桨坐了九年,如今我没什么可埋的,也没什么可烧的。等过了那道岬角,我对着海把话说了,这就算他的葬礼。别站在这儿办。你站在这儿办,他非得揍你一拳不可。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-gangplank.text: 船长。——船长。跟我一起数。你,我,佩里墨得斯,还有火堆边那个什么都没看见的小子。从那座山上下来的是四个。这一路我数了三遍,遍遍都是四个。——上跳板。上跳板去,船长,我要哭就到桨上哭,像个水手那样哭。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.0.label: 我们还有多少工夫?
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.1.label: 里头那张床,你看见了。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.2.label: 拿了就走。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.2.toolti: 你说得对。拿上奶酪,回船。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.3.label: 我们等。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.3.toolti: 我们等。我要见见挤这些奶的人。
content.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.text: 你看这酪的个头,船长。一个村子一冬天也吃不完,还一直码到房顶。羔子都饮过水了,奶桶还带着体温。——你一句话,趁他还没下山,我们就能满怀抱地走下这条路。
content.dlg.eurylochus.heed.opt.0.label: (下山,回船。)
content.dlg.eurylochus.heed.text: 谢天谢地,一次把所有神都谢一遍。拿上,扛走,别为羊羔吵——就该这么办。奶酪进舱,天黑前桨下水,一个月内到伊萨卡。你会有一个又长又清静的晚年,没有一个人会为它编歌。下船去吧,船长,趁天还亮。
content.dlg.eurylochus.how-long.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.how-long.text: 火是压着的,不是熄的——他是让它留着,那就是打算回来。羊群在外头,他也就跟着羊群在外头。算它黄昏,不能再晚了。天底下的牧人都是黄昏赶羊回圈。
content.dlg.eurylochus.inside.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.inside.text: 奶酪,比一个村子一冬天吃的还多。栏分得规规矩矩,羔子、当年的、成年的各归各;干这活的人是懂行的。里头还铺着一张床,青树枝的。……船长,我脑子里绕来绕去的,是那张床的长度。
content.dlg.eurylochus.never-saw.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.never-saw.text: 没见过他。好。——一船人从一座没打过仗的岛上整整齐齐回了家,这种事没人会编成歌,而我从龙骨到桅杆都乐意。让诗人们饿着去吧。我只想我的人接着有饭吃。
content.dlg.eurylochus.no-argument.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.no-argument.text: 那我就收下,不多讨了。——只说一句,说完就撂开,船长:你掉头了。你脸上是那副要死人的神色,可你还是掉头了。我宁愿跟着那个掉头的人出海。
content.dlg.eurylochus.overrule.opt.0.label: (那就等。)
content.dlg.eurylochus.overrule.text: 当然要等。你想亲眼看看。你永远都想亲眼看看那个东西。——好吧。可有一条:从那洞口进来的无论是什么,不会因为你正好站在它家里,就欠你一份待客的礼数。让佩里墨得斯跟紧你。还有,船长——这辈子就这一回,求你安静点。
content.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.0.label: 我不争。
content.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.1.label: 我们没见过他。
content.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.1.tooltip: 我们没见过他。回伊萨卡就这么说。
content.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.2.label: (上船。)
content.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.text: 一个不少。船长——一个不少。我数了两遍,跟上岸时是同一个数;九年了,在岛上我从没能说出这句话。——奶酪进了舱,羊羔还在上头叫唤,而看着它们的那位回家会发现少了一整轮,却永远不知道是怎么少的。
content.dlg.eurylochus.right-about-it.text: 我说对了,代价是一条人命,所以你我都别拿它做文章。——我要的是另一样,船长。下一座岛,我说那股烟不对劲的时候,你在拿主意之前先数到十。数十下。这就是我全部的价钱。
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.0.label: 我们是谁?打开天窗说。
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.1.label: 这是谁的岛?
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.2.label: 里面有什么?
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.2.tooltip: 探子在洞里看见了什么?
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.text: 船长。这片沙滩上我们十二个人;趁你还没拦我,我先把话说了:那股烟我看着不对。上头奶酪一直码到房顶,羔子分了栏,奶桶还带着奶的温度——人却不在。今晚有人要回那所屋子,而且他一点也不必赶路。
content.dlg.eurylochus.the-bed.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.the-bed.text: 青树枝,铺法是一个人给自己铺的那种铺法。有人在这儿睡觉,船长,而且睡得踏实——在一座没有围墙、没有看门狗的岛上。你把这话琢磨透了,再跟我说你想跟他握手。
content.dlg.eurylochus.where.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.where.text: 不知道——我反对的就是这个'不知道'。我们是从雾里进来的:没有港,没有犁过的地,没有界石。这里从来没人开过一道犁沟。养这些羊群的东西不做买卖,不种地,也没有哪家邻居需要它赔笑脸。
content.dlg.eurylochus.who.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.eurylochus.who.text: 你是奥德修斯,拉埃尔特斯之子,伊萨卡之王——而我是你妻子的兄弟,所以我才敢这么跟你说话。特洛伊塌了;整整十年,收尾那匹木马还是你出的主意。打那以后我们就一直在往家赶,可大海不肯还我们伊萨卡,只一座接一座地塞岛屿过来。这就是我们,船长。一群九年前就该到家的人。
content.dlg.perimedes.after-the-eye.opt.0.label: 隔这么远他也听得见?
content.dlg.perimedes.after-the-eye.opt.1.label: (往高处走。)
content.dlg.perimedes.after-the-eye.text: 成了。你做成了,成了,别那样看着我——轻点,轻点——他起来了。他起来了,两只手已经摸上墙。他会摸到羊栏的,船长;他闭着眼熟悉这块地,比我们点着灯还熟。往高处走。躲到公羊后头,往高处走。
content.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.opt.0.label: 他会知道。可他不会知道是谁。
content.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.opt.1.label: 把酒收回舱。
content.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.opt.1.tooltip: 把酒囊搬回舱里去,小子。
content.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.text: 真快啊船长。那简直是——进去又出来,你看,我两只手都还在。我一直等着为那轮酪心虚,可这份心虚到现在也没来。——你说他会数吗?我是说那些酪。你说他会发现吗?
content.dlg.perimedes.four-right.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.four-right.text: 四个。那我不数了。——石头落下来的时候我僵住了,船长。欧律洛科斯揪着我的领子,我的腿一点不听使唤。我等了一整夜,等你说我一句。你没说。这件事我会记得比记得那个巨人还久。
content.dlg.perimedes.giant.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.giant.text: 一只眼,长在额头正中,他就这一只——我逼着自己看清楚的。他站直了,头蹭着洞顶。还有,船长,他说话。这是我最没防备的一条。他说起话来跟人一样。他问我们是谁,问得还挺客气。
content.dlg.perimedes.he-hears.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.he-hears.text: 什么都听得见。我踢到一粒石子,他当场就转过来了。脚掌整个落地,用嘴呼吸,他一停你就停。诀窍全在这儿了,我已经练了一个钟头。
content.dlg.perimedes.just-arrived.opt.0.label: 跟紧我。
content.dlg.perimedes.just-arrived.opt.1.label: 替我盯着洞口。
content.dlg.perimedes.just-arrived.text: 我来了,船长,我来了——连酒囊一块儿,我自己背上来的。——天哪,这味儿。奶味、烟味、湿羊毛味。这里头是有人过日子的。
content.dlg.perimedes.on-the-sand.opt.0.label: 就是四个。
content.dlg.perimedes.on-the-sand.opt.1.label: 到桨那儿去,小子。
content.dlg.perimedes.on-the-sand.text: 我们出来了。船长,我们出来了,脚底下是沙子——我抓了两把羊毛,你看,毛还在我手里,整把揪下来的。——四个。我数出来是四个。你告诉我四个是对的。
content.dlg.perimedes.out.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.out.text: 每面石壁我都走了两遍。羊栏在后头,他的火塘更深处,另有一条缝,猫都钻不过去。一个洞口,一块石头。不过它一天开两回,船长——羊群总得出去吃草,再回来。我能报的就这些。哦,还有一条:他挤完奶就躺倒,睡得沉。回回如此。
content.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.0.label: 告诉我,他是什么。
content.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.1.label: 有别的出路吗?
content.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.2.label: 我们动脑子。
content.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.2.tooltip: 那就不跟他打。我们动脑子。
content.dlg.perimedes.root.text: 船长。石头落了——他把最后一头母羊赶进来,顺手就把它滚上了,跟人关门一样,看都没看。二十二驾大车也拽不动它。我们跟他关在一起了。他还抓走了安提福斯,拎着脚踝提起来的。同一支桨划了九年,安提福斯连一个字都没喊出来。
content.dlg.perimedes.stay-close.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.stay-close.text: 跟紧你。好。——我不说话。我知道我话多。安提福斯说我这张嘴迟早害死一船人,他说的时候像在开玩笑,可我近来觉着他是当真的。
content.dlg.perimedes.to-the-oars.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.to-the-oars.text: 桨。好。总算能抓点不是羊的东西了。——我拉到手掌开花都行,船长,只求在他想起来往海里扔东西之前,我们已经绕过那道岬角。
content.dlg.perimedes.under-the-ram.opt.0.label: 你在哪一头?
content.dlg.perimedes.under-the-ram.text: 钻进去。快钻进去。——两手抓死肚子上的毛,两脚在背上勾住,让它驮你走出去;这些家伙有当年牛犊那么大,驮得动你。——船长。等光打到你脸上的时候,千万别松手,也别抬头看他。不管你听见他说什么,他说的都是给脊背听的。
content.dlg.perimedes.watch-mouth.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.watch-mouth.text: 洞口。好。——外头那片光很大,船长,而且正在变小。有什么东西挡过去,我立刻告诉你。我真心希望我是多虑。
content.dlg.perimedes.where-be.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.where-be.text: 从栏门数第三头公羊,跟你一样。我这边要是出岔子,你只管往前走——这是我下给你的命令,我这辈子不会再有第二次机会下命令了,就让我下这一回。
content.dlg.perimedes.wine-below.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.wine-below.text: 搬回舱里。好。——那本来是给一个陌生人当见面礼的,可我们压根没碰上那个陌生人,那就塞回草垛里去。我宁可再扛着它上一趟山,也不想弄明白我们本来是留着它对付什么。
content.dlg.perimedes.wont-know-who.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.perimedes.wont-know-who.text: 他会发现,可他永远不知道是谁。——老天,为这种事得意实在太不像话了,而我就是得意。我打算一路得意到家。
content.dlg.polyphemus.flock.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.polyphemus.flock.text: 我的。每头母羊,每头公羊,每只开春落地的羊羔,都是我的。我认它们不靠数,靠手感;黑灯瞎火里我也摸得出哪只是哪只——多数夜里我就是这么干的。你们进了我的家,吃了我的奶酪。奶酪的事,我不生气。
content.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.0.label: 你是谁?
content.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.1.label: 这羊群是谁的?
content.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.2.label: 这里就没有一点规矩王法吗?
content.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.3.label: 我船上的酒。
content.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.3.tooltip: 我船上带了酒。收下它,拿我当回客人。
content.dlg.polyphemus.guest.text: 你还醒着,小东西。很好。睡着的东西没滋味,跟没盐的饼一个样。坐。说话——要是说话也算你会的本事。前头那几个就不怎么说。也没说多久。
content.dlg.polyphemus.law.opt.0.label: 那就送你酒。
content.dlg.polyphemus.law.opt.0.tooltip: 那换我送你一份礼。酒,船上带来的。
content.dlg.polyphemus.law.opt.1.label: 回。
content.dlg.polyphemus.law.text: 王法。这词儿我认得——人们把它带进来,跟衣裳上沾的味儿似的。你要跟我说:宙斯是庇护生人的神,客人当有吃食,当得礼物,当全须全尾地送走。可我们比宙斯来得早,也比他强壮。在我自己家里,我想怎样就怎样。这就是这座岛全部的王法,而这王法,从头到尾就是我。
content.dlg.polyphemus.name-boast.opt.0.label: (他睡着了。)
content.dlg.polyphemus.name-boast.text: 奥德修斯。——奥德修斯,屠城者。你把它撂下来,像撂一枚自己很得意的钱币,等着看我的脸色。我没给脸色。不过在我自己家里,别人告诉我的事,我一件件都记着;这脑袋里也没装过多少别的。你的礼是:我最后一个吃你。——喔。洞顶在转……待到天亮吧,屠城者。
content.dlg.polyphemus.name-lie.opt.0.label: (他睡着了。)
content.dlg.polyphemus.name-lie.text: 艾通。克里特来的。——克里特人说谎;这名声连这儿都传到了。不过你好歹给了个名字,我要的就是名字,那我就不跟它计较。我的礼:我最后一个吃艾通。——喔。杯子,洞顶,那个……待到天亮吧,克里特人。
content.dlg.polyphemus.name-nobody.opt.0.label: (他睡着了。)
content.dlg.polyphemus.name-nobody.text: 无人。——无人。好一个又穷又薄的名字;你爹娘多半不怎么疼你。那么,这是你的客人礼,还是份厚礼:这么些人里,我最后一个吃'无人'。留到最末。——喔。杯子飞到洞顶上去了,洞顶在转……待到天亮吧,无人。这洞里好久好久没有东西回过嘴了。
content.dlg.polyphemus.self.opt.0.label: 回。
content.dlg.polyphemus.self.text: 波吕斐摩斯。我父亲是波塞冬,他在海底下走动,不痛快了就摇一摇海床。这座岛上除了我和羊群再没有别人——没有我要搭话的邻居,没有人来,没有人问。从你们那族人还没想出船这种东西起,就是这样了。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.0.label: 无人。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.0.tooltip: 无人。我娘叫我无人,我爹,我的朋友——个个都这么叫。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.1.label: 奥德修斯。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.1.tooltip: 奥德修斯,拉埃尔特斯之子。屠城者。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.2.label: 艾通。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.2.tooltip: 艾通。跑买卖的,克里特来的。
content.dlg.polyphemus.wine.text: ……这是什么。这到底是什么。我们这儿也榨酒,就在羊栏边那架藤上;又薄又酸,倒也实在,我喝了一辈子。跟这个不沾边。这是人做梦才梦得着的酒。再给我。再来一口。——啊。……小东西。你敬了我一回,我也得还你一回——这是你们的王法,是不是。把名字告诉我,我给你一份待客的礼。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.done.0.arrive.1.narrat: 欧律罗科斯挤进你身旁的石缝,拔着一柄毫无用处的剑,从牙缝里呼吸。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.checkpoint.0.respaw: 你在架子那头的东侧阴影里醒转,冰凉的石壁抵着后背,喉咙里全是奶酪味和陈年的烟味。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.checkpoint.1.narrat: 奶酪一直码到房顶,羔子按大小分了栏,架子上的奶桶还带着奶的温度。这屋子的主人今早出门的时候,是打算今晚再走进来的。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.checkpoint.5.narrat: 佩里墨得斯背着船上的酒囊,贴着你的脚跟进来,把整座大厅扫视一遍,然后背靠货架边的凹壁站定。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.cheese.1.narrate: 一轮硬黄奶酪,沉得像面盾。佩里墨得斯把船上带的酒囊塞进你另一只手:"我亲自背上来的,船长。万一得把哪个生人变成客人呢。"
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.the-argument.2.arri: 你话还没说完,佩里墨得斯已经出了洞口,顺着山路跑在所有人前头;等大家陆续踏上沙滩,他一个一个点着数。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.the-argument.3.arri: 安提福斯一言不发,扛起口袋往坡下走。算术,船长:进来时有的,一样不少;还多赚一轮奶酪。
content.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.the-argument.4.arri: 欧律洛科斯最后一个下来,绳圈还挂在肩上。他站在跳板边,一个一个地数着上船的人,出声地数,数了两遍。
content.fx.follow-the-smoke.oc.reach-mouth.1.nar: 洞口呼出凉气和陈年的烟味。欧律罗科斯先你一步跨了进去。
content.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.14.seq.10.1.narrat: 巨石磨着洞口碾过去。天光收成一条线,又收成没有。
content.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.14.seq.7.0.narrate: 他头也没回,拎起一个人的脚踝,那手势跟扶正一只碰倒的奶桶没有两样。是安提福斯。谁都没来得及出声。
content.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.15.respawn.6.narra: 你在大厅那一头东侧凹壁的黑暗里醒来。巨人是他自家火堆旁的一团影子,正在挤奶,不慌不忙。
content.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.3.narrate: 待在阴影里,看着。此刻归家的东西,从来不是你能对付的。
content.fx.hide.oc.the-stone.0.narrate: "一只眼,长在额头正中,说话跟人一样——问我们是谁,还问得挺客气。那块石头当年二十二驾大车才安上,他单手就滚回去了。这仗打不得,船长。我们动脑子。"
content.fx.nobody.done.1.narrate: 佩里墨得斯从巨人码好的木料里拖出一根青橄榄木,搁进你手里:"跟桅杆一样粗,船长。咱们把它削出个尖来。"
content.fx.nobody.oc.the-name.1.narrate: 马戎的酒开始做它的事。他的下巴一点点沉到胸口,整座洞随之涨满他呼吸的长潮。
content.fx.shipwrecked.done.0.narrate: 安提福斯把酒和粮袋往肩上一甩:"总得有人替那位扛晚饭。"说完便跟在你身后。埃尔佩诺尔独自留下守火——把火烧得很旺。
content.fx.shipwrecked.done.1.arrive.0.narrate: 安提福斯把口袋卸在洞口的光里,就站在那儿喘匀气,数着羊羔。
content.fx.shipwrecked.oc.climb-out.1.narrate: 欧律罗科斯把一盘绳索甩上肩,踏上磨旧的小路。跟着那缕烟走。
content.fx.take-the-cheese.oc.board-flee.0.narra: 桨探了出去,沙滩从船尾溜走,羊羔的抱怨声还留在上面。没人回头看那座山,也没人非回头不可。
content.fx.take-the-cheese.oc.flee-back.0.narrat: 奶酪夹在臂弯里,身后栏里的羔子还在叫唤。这一回不会有人编成歌,船长。你只是平平安安回到家而已。
content.fx.the-sail.oc.board-nobody.0.narrate: 桨伸出去,沙滩从船尾溜走。没有人回头看那座山;在谁有心思开口之前,得先把一大片空海横在你们和它中间。
content.fx.the-sail.oc.last-sand.1.narrate: 在你身后的高处,那个瞎了的巨人没有退回洞里。他把自己横在自家洞口,双手前伸,侧着头,等一个可以恨的声响。还留在里头的东西,如今都归他了。
content.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.10.seq.0.1.narrate: 上坡道。别弄出一点他能循着找来的声音。
他的头猛地甩向你。定住——退回阴影里去。
content.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.6.narrate: 群山应答他。他的族类隔着石头喊进来:"波吕斐摩斯!谁在杀你?"他把毁掉的脸抵着岩石吼回去:"无人!是无人在杀我!"片刻的静。然后,脚步声往山上去了:"既然无人害你,那就是宙斯降的病。祷告你父亲去吧。"脚步声再没有回来。他听着它们走远。
content.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.7.narrate: 群山应答他。他的族类隔着石头喊进来:"波吕斐摩斯!这是谁干的?"他吼回去的,是你就着酒撂下的那个名字,完完整整,响响亮亮:"奥德修斯!屠城者,拉埃尔特斯之子,伊萨卡人——他就在我屋檐底下!"他们信了。"稳住,兄弟——石头在外头搬不动。等天亮;天一亮,全山的手一起来开。"佩里墨得斯攥住你的袖子:"他们天亮就回来,船长。我们得赶在羊群前头走。"
content.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.8.narrate: 群山应答他。他的族类隔着石头喊进来:"波吕斐摩斯!这是谁干的?"他吼回去的,是你就着酒给他的那个名字:"艾通!克里特人,克里特来的——就在我自己的火边!"一阵静。然后,冷冷地、已经在转身了:"克里特人啊。兄弟,克里特人说谎,天下就知道他们这一条。睡一觉去吧。"脚步声走了,不紧不慢,什么也没信,今夜不会再回来。
content.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.9.respawn.4.narrat: 你在东侧凹壁里醒来,火光照不到那里。瞎了的巨人还在洞底一圈圈踱着,双手前探,听着。
content.fx.the-stake.oc.climb-to-pen.2.narrate: 公羊挤满上层的圈,温热,愚钝,大得吓人。你脚下,巨人在他再也看不见的地面上来回踱步。
content.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.3.narrate: 四面都是空海,桨也找准了节奏。黑暗背后那座岛还在那儿,可它已经是别人的麻烦了。
content.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.5.seq.1.1.narrat: 洞是你赢下来的。他会把这事讲到咽气那天,而那个名字他一次也不会讲对;连摸到石头前的邻居们也都回自己的火堆边去了,只当他是害了病。没有歌,没有传令官,岸上没有一个人会听见这件事。你就得靠这个活下去。你只能靠这个活下去。
content.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.5.seq.1.2.narrat: 洞是你赢下来的——然后你在上面签了名。船尾那个方向,整座山都醒着:坡上到处是手,族亲一个个喊着族亲,天一亮他们全会赶去搬开那块石头,而石头后面那个人,如今能把你和你父亲的名字一并报给大海。欧律洛科斯把桨速压住了,一眼也不回头。你在那里头买下的东西,海水迟早会来收账。
content.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.5.seq.1.3.narrat: 洞是你赢下来的,功劳记在一个克里特人头上。群山听见了那个名字,掂了掂,又睡回去了——克里特来的行商,而克里特人说谎,所以等于什么都没听见。没人会去找艾通;世上本来就没有一个艾通可找。你有你的人,你的水,和一片干净的海平线;而你一生里最漂亮的一个钟头,属于一个不存在的人。
content.fx.trig.boulder-wont-move.0.narrate: 你把肩膀抵上巨石。它纹丝不动,连磨都不磨一下。你带的任何刃口都啃不动它——能打开这座洞的,不会是你。
content.fx.trig.he-holds-the-mouth.1.narrate: 你的脚在洞口碾动了一粒石子,他的头循着这点动静猛地转过来,像一扇门砸上。他对群山说过,你是他最后才吃的那一个。他可没说他不吃了。
content.fx.trig.his-house.0.narrate: 你的剑砍在他皮上,像木棍敲在船骨上。他放下了奶桶。很慢。在他自己的家里,在他自己的石头底下,你竟对他动了手——他起身了,要还你一个十足的回答。
content.fx.trig.wake-the-giant.1.narrate: 熟睡的神之子,动他不得。他带着全身的力气从地上起来——这座洞里没有东西挡得住他。
content.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.1.3: 他挨着缺口旁的岩壁坐稳,两只手在洞口上方张开,挨个抚过走出去的脊背。只摸脊背。他压根没想过要往肚子底下摸一把。

content.obj.cave-of-plenty.checkpoint.hint: 过了洞口往里走,到架子开始的第一片开阔石台。
content.obj.cave-of-plenty.checkpoint.title: 走进洞里
content.obj.cave-of-plenty.cheese.hint: 入口边的架子上,奶酪一直码到洞顶。取一轮就好。
content.obj.cave-of-plenty.cheese.title: 取一轮奶酪
content.obj.cave-of-plenty.the-argument.hint: 他就在奶酪架边你的身侧。告诉他:是跑回船上,还是留下来等这座洞的主人。
content.obj.cave-of-plenty.the-argument.title: 和欧律罗科斯拿主意
content.obj.follow-the-smoke.reach-mouth.hint: 跟在他身后离开沙滩:穿过放牧的草场,经过那座垒好却空着的石头羊圈,沿山壁盘道一路向上,直到烟升起的洞口——巨石就歇在洞口旁。
content.obj.follow-the-smoke.reach-mouth.title: 跟欧律罗科斯上山
content.obj.hide.take-cover.hint: 天光在退,有什么东西正上坡来。贴进石壁上那些黑暗的壁龛里,看着。
content.obj.hide.take-cover.title: 躲进阴影
content.obj.hide.the-stone.hint: 等石头落定、巨人坐下挤奶,去货架边的凹壁里找到佩里墨得斯,问清走进来的是什么。
content.obj.hide.the-stone.title: 在黑暗里找到佩里墨得斯
content.obj.nobody.the-name.hint: 波吕斐摩斯坐在洞厅中央的大火堆旁。先去见他,别碰他的东西——酒的事,讲点规矩。
content.obj.nobody.the-name.title: 见一见洞的主人
content.obj.shipwrecked.climb-out.hint: 他还在火边,望着山上的烟。给他一句话,让他带路。
content.obj.shipwrecked.climb-out.title: 告诉欧律罗科斯:上山
content.obj.take-the-cheese.board-flee.hint: 趁那座洞背后还空无一人,走过跳板,回到你的桨位上。
content.obj.take-the-cheese.board-flee.title: 登船
content.obj.take-the-cheese.flee-back.hint: 沿来路下山:过羊圈,过火堆,回到跳板——船在那里等。
content.obj.take-the-cheese.flee-back.title: 跑回船上
content.obj.the-sail.board-nobody.hint: 走过跳板,站上甲板。不管你打算怎么同他道别——海在听。
content.obj.the-sail.board-nobody.title: 登船,开桨
content.obj.the-sail.last-sand.hint: 下山,回到沙滩。船就泊在跳板边,桨手齐备,只等你。
content.obj.the-sail.last-sand.title: 下山回船
content.obj.the-stake.blind.hint: 酒放倒了他,他歪在自己的火边。把烧硬的尖头对准那只独眼,压上你全身的分量。
content.obj.the-stake.blind.missing_item_hint: 你把手按在那片阖着的巨大眼睑上。是温的,而且在动。巨人隔着酒意咕哝出一句,人却没醒:"……唔。还没到。黑的那头还没挤呢……"——你的手只是一只手,又滑了下来。
content.obj.the-stake.blind.title: 捅灭那只眼
content.obj.the-stake.climb-to-pen.hint: 由他冲着地面咆哮去。从阴影挪到阴影,顺石坡道往上层羊圈走。别跑,别跳——他现在靠声音打猎。
content.obj.the-stake.climb-to-pen.title: 摸上羊圈
content.obj.the-stake.grind.hint: 巨人在西侧地面的光井下摆着一台磨石。把橄榄木桩抵上去,磨出尖来。
content.obj.the-stake.grind.missing_item_hint: 石轮在你掌心底下慢慢转满一圈,什么也没咬着。
content.obj.the-stake.grind.title: 磨尖木桩
content.obj.the-stake.harden.hint: 带着磨尖的木桩,到大厅正中那座石砌围炉去,把尖头插进炭火里转,直到烧得又黑又硬。
content.obj.the-stake.harden.title: 在火里烧硬
content.obj.the-voyage.aboard.hint: 岛在船尾,而且正在退远。找到你那条桨凳,剩下的交给水。
content.obj.the-voyage.aboard.title: 就位划桨
content.obj.under-the-rams.under-ram.hint: 抓住最大那头公羊肚腹的两把厚毛,贴紧,别出声,等羊群出圈时让它驮你走。
content.obj.under-the-rams.under-ram.title: 钻到公羊肚子下
content.quest.cave-of-plenty.goal: 洞里奶酪堆到顶,羊羔关得整整齐齐。取一轮奶酪,然后跟欧律罗科斯拿个主意:能拿多少拿多少赶紧回船,还是留下来,等这座洞的主人回家。
content.quest.follow-the-smoke.goal: 跟着欧律罗科斯离开沙滩,穿过草场上那座空羊圈,登上山壁的盘道,走到那缕烟升起的洞口。
content.quest.hide.goal: 天黑了,主人到家了。躲进壁龛的阴影里,别出声——看着波吕斐摩斯把羊群赶进来,用一块没人搬得动的石头封住洞口,然后带走你们中的第一个。
content.quest.nobody.goal: 同巨人一起被封在洞里。在他自己的火堆边把烈酒递给他,收下他回敬的'礼',再回敬他一个名字——一个他日后咒骂起来一文不值的名字。
content.quest.shipwrecked.goal: 在山脚的沙滩上醒来,山上冒着烟。到浮木火堆边领一份行头,打退从浪里爬出来的溺尸,听欧律罗科斯把话说完,再上山。
content.quest.take-the-cheese.goal: 你选了大海。趁天光未尽溜下山去,趁那座洞背后还空无一人,从跳板登船。
content.quest.the-sail.goal: 登船,把这座岛甩在船尾。无论你以什么方式离开它——海都记得岛上说过的话。
content.quest.the-stake.goal: 趁他睡着,把橄榄木桩在他自己的磨石上磨尖,在火里烧硬,捅进那只独眼。然后跟着瞎了的他摸上坡道,朝羊圈去——别给他任何一点可以追猎的声音。
content.quest.the-voyage.goal: 站在甲板上,岛已经落在身后;听一听你留下的那个故事将会是什么样子。
content.quest.under-the-rams.goal: 他瞎了,守在洞口听着。混进上层羊圈的公羊中间,让羊群驮着你出去,下山,回到跳板和等着的船桨那里。
content.world.boundary.message: 浪涛缠住你的腿,把你拖回沙滩。
content.world.title: 无人之岛
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.3.label: 带路吧。
content.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.4.label: 说说那轮酪。
content.cast.cave-of-plenty.eurylochus.2.bark.0: 拿一轮酪在手里掂掂,船长。掂完了,你再当着我的面说我们留下。
content.cast.cave-of-plenty.eurylochus.2.bark.1: 这一排架子上的东西,够十二个人吃一个星期。他根本数不过来。
content.cast.cave-of-plenty.eurylochus.2.bark.2: 奶桶还是温的。温的,船长。你算算这意味着他离得有多近。
content.cast.hide.perimedes.2.bark.0: (压着嗓子)他在一只只点进洞,船长。你看——每过一只,他都要摸一下背毛。
content.cast.hide.perimedes.2.bark.1: (压着嗓子)他走的每一步我都记着。往后总有人要问,这事是怎么办成的。
content.cast.hide.perimedes.2.bark.2: (压着嗓子)等那块石头落下来,黑透的那一阵别动。过了再说话。
content.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.0.5: 石头从洞口磨开——外面却没有天光。瞎子分不出正午和半夜,他把自家的门开向了一片黑天,天底下的海整个立了起来。
content.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.7.0: 咸腥的风,里头一点光也没有。在这片喧闹底下,某个极古老的声音正听人禀报他儿子的遭遇,海水开始不对劲地涌上来。

一个月内到伊萨卡。安全,吃得饱,也因此小了那么一点——而同你上岛的每一个人,都还在自己的桨位上。
content.fx.the-quiet-voyage.oc.out-to-sea.4.narr: 四面都是空海,桨也找准了节奏。你身后,那座岛留着它的巨人、它的奶酪和它的故事——只少了一轮酪,而无人知晓。
content.quest.the-quiet-voyage.goal: 你选了海,海也接住了你:带着同你上岛的每一个人把岛甩在船尾,听听这份安静的代价。
content.fx.the-sail.oc.last-sand.3.narrate: 跳板就在十步开外,而大海连这十步也不情愿让给你:浅滩在你背后吐出它的死人。
content.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.7.3: 别停下来跟它们打。这座岛上没有一样东西值得再搭上一个人。下山,回到桨边去。

source.cast.under-the-rams.eurylochus.0.bark.2: When the stone goes, look at the sand. Look at the sand and think about the sand.
source.class.odysseus.blurb: King of Ithaca, ten years at Troy, and still not home. The wooden horse was your idea. You have never won a fight you could win another way, which is fortunate, because nothing in this cave can be won by fighting. A short sword you will barely draw, pitch-pine to hold back the dark, and the grey-eyed goddess watching over your shoulder. The strong wine of Maron waits in the hold below; the men will carry it up when the moment comes. There is no one else to be on this island — the crew are yours, and so is whatever you talk them into.

source.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.0.label: Hold the light.
source.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.0.tooltip: Rest here. Hold the light for us.
source.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.1.label: That bed.
source.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.opt.1.tooltip: The bed at the back — you saw it.
source.dlg.antiphos.at-the-mouth.text: Set them down here, Captain, if it is all the same — my knees are done for the day. (he counts the pens off on one finger) Lambs, yearlings, full-grown. Three pens, sorted right. Whoever keeps this flock is a proper herdsman, and I would feel better about that if he were a proper size.
source.dlg.antiphos.boy.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.antiphos.boy.text: Elpenor. Aye. He'll do something brave and stupid before this is done — his kind always does. That's why he keeps the fire and I carry the sacks: one of us needs both hands free to haul the other one home.
source.dlg.antiphos.hold-light.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.antiphos.hold-light.text: Hold the light. That I can do. — Go careful in there, Captain. And send the boy Perimedes back out to me if he gets loud; he is better use where he can breathe.
source.dlg.antiphos.rest.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.antiphos.rest.text: Rest. There's a word. — I'll rest when we're off this rock, Captain, and not one hour before. Till then you do what you do best: think us out of it. I'll carry what needs carrying.
source.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.0.label: Seen this before?
source.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.0.tooltip: You've seen islands like this before.
source.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.1.label: Watch the boy.
source.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.1.tooltip: Keep an eye on the boy for me.
source.dlg.antiphos.root.opt.2.label: Rest while you can, old man.
source.dlg.antiphos.root.text: Nine years on the same oar, Captain, and here is what it taught me: the sea doesn't hate you. It doesn't know you're there. Everything on this island that troubles me, troubles me because it might.
source.dlg.antiphos.seen.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.antiphos.seen.text: Seen enough of them. The good ones have smoke and a dog barking and someone who comes down to the water to see who you are. This one has smoke and no dog and no one. Whatever is up that mountain has never once had to wonder who was coming, and I would dearly like to know why.
source.dlg.antiphos.the-size.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.antiphos.the-size.text: I saw it. I have been working at un-seeing it ever since. — Captain, I have buried eleven men out of this crew and I have never once been the man who says turn back. I am not saying it now either. I am telling you I have noticed I want to.
source.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.opt.0.label: I told you.
source.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.opt.0.tooltip: Nobody got left behind. I told you.
source.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.opt.1.label: Douse it. We're away.
source.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.opt.1.tooltip: Douse the fire, lad. We're away.
source.dlg.elpenor.all-of-you.text: That is — hold on. Hold on, that is all of you. — I had it worked out, Captain, I had the whole speech worked out for when it was not all of you, and now I have to just stand here with it. — Somebody take a sack off me before I say something stupid.
source.dlg.elpenor.didnt-come-down.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.didnt-come-down.text: Oh. — Oh. All right. All right. — He carried my sacks the whole first year, because I could not, and I never once said thank you for it. I just let him. — Give me an oar, Captain. I need a thing to be doing with my hands.
source.dlg.elpenor.douse-it.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.douse-it.text: Douse it. Right. — It never went out, Captain, not once, and I know that is not a thing anyone will remember. I will remember it.
source.dlg.elpenor.get-aboard.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.get-aboard.text: Aboard. Aye. — You came back. You said nobody gets left behind, and you came back, and I had stopped believing it about four hours ago, so I want that on the record and I want to be sorry for it out loud.
source.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.0.label: Stay by the fire.
source.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.0.tooltip: Stay by the fire and you'll be all right.
source.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.1.label: Why the sea, lad?
source.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.1.tooltip: Why did you come to sea, lad?
source.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.2.label: You have my word.
source.dlg.elpenor.root.opt.2.tooltip: Nobody gets left behind. You have my word.
source.dlg.elpenor.root.text: Is it true what they saw in the cave, Captain? Tell me it isn't. — No, don't, I can see your face. It's fine. It's fine! I'm fine. I signed on to see the world, and this is the world, so. Ha. So this is it. ... You'll not leave me behind up there, will you?
source.dlg.elpenor.stay.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.stay.text: By the fire. Right. I'm good by the fire — I can keep a fire, I'm not useless. It's the dark past the light I don't like, and that cave is all dark. ... I'll keep the fire, Captain. You come back and it'll still be burning. That's my part. I can do that part.
source.dlg.elpenor.the-fire-held.opt.0.label: He didn't come down.
source.dlg.elpenor.the-fire-held.opt.1.label: Get aboard, lad.
source.dlg.elpenor.the-fire-held.text: CAPTAIN! — Captain, you are — look at it, look, it never went out, not once, not all night. — Where is Antiphos. ... Where is Antiphos, Captain.
source.dlg.elpenor.told-you.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.told-you.text: You told me. You did tell me. — I am going to be insufferable about this for a week, I want you to know that in advance. My mother said the sea takes the greenest one first and the sea did not take anybody, so as far as I am concerned my mother owes me a letter.
source.dlg.elpenor.why.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.why.text: To be more than the youngest son of a small farm, Captain. My mother told me not to sail — she said the sea takes the greenest ones first. I laughed at her. ... I've stopped laughing about it, if that's what you're asking. But I'd still rather be here and afraid than home and nothing.
source.dlg.elpenor.word.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.elpenor.word.text: Your word. — All right. All right, then. If Odysseus of Ithaca says nobody gets left behind, that's as good as a rope in my hand. I'll hold you to it, Captain, and I'll hold myself together till you do. Go on. Go be clever at it. We'll be here.
source.dlg.eurylochus.antiphos-gone.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.antiphos-gone.text: Aye. Antiphos. — Nine years on the bench behind mine, and I have nothing to bury and nothing to burn. When we are clear of the headland I will say the words over the water, and that will have to serve for a funeral. Do not stand here doing it. He would have thumped you for standing here doing it.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-gangplank.opt.1.to: You were right about the smoke.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-gangplank.text: Captain. — Captain. Count with me. You, me, Perimedes, and the lad at the fire who never had to see any of it. Four came down off that mountain. I have counted it three times on the path and it keeps coming out four. — Get on the plank. Get on the plank, and I will do my grieving at the oar, like a sailor.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.0.label: How long have we got?
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.1.label: You saw the bed at the back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.2.label: Take it and run.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.2.toolti: You're right. Take the cheese and run for the ship.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.3.label: We wait.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.opt.3.toolti: We wait. I would meet the man who milks them.
source.dlg.eurylochus.at-the-racks.text: Look at the size of the wheels, Captain. A village could not eat this in a winter and it is stacked to the roof. The lambs are watered. The pails are warm. — Say the word and we are down the path with our arms full before he is off the mountain.
source.dlg.eurylochus.heed.opt.0.label: (Down to the ship.)
source.dlg.eurylochus.heed.text: Thank every god at once. Grab, carry, go, and no arguing about the lambs. — And that is how it should go. Cheese in the hold, oars in the water before dark, Ithaca inside the month. You'll have a long quiet old age and not one soul will make a song of it. Down to the ship, Captain, while the light lasts.
source.dlg.eurylochus.how-long.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.how-long.text: The fire is banked, not dead — he set it to keep, which means he means to come back to it. And the flock is out, so he is out with the flock. Call it dusk, and I would not call it later. Every shepherd who ever lived brings them in at dusk.
source.dlg.eurylochus.inside.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.inside.text: Cheese, more than a village eats in a winter. Pens sorted properly, lambs from yearlings from full-grown; whoever does it knows the work. And at the back, a bed made of green branches. ... It is the length of that bed I keep coming back to, Captain.
source.dlg.eurylochus.never-saw.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.never-saw.text: Never saw him. Aye. — Nobody will make a song of a crew that came home whole off an island they never had a fight on, and that suits me down to the keel. Let the poets go hungry. I would like my men to go on eating.
source.dlg.eurylochus.no-argument.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.no-argument.text: Then I will take it and not push my luck. — I will say one thing and then let it go, Captain: you turned round. You had that look on, the one that gets men killed, and you turned round anyway. I would rather sail with the man who turned round.
source.dlg.eurylochus.overrule.opt.0.label: (Then we wait.)
source.dlg.eurylochus.overrule.text: Of course we wait. You want to see it. You always want to see the thing. — Fine. Whatever comes through that mouth does not owe you a guest's welcome just because you're standing in its house. Keep Perimedes close, and Captain — for once in your life, be ready to be quiet.
source.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.0.label: No argument.
source.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.0.tooltip: You'll get no argument from me tonight.
source.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.1.label: We never saw him.
source.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.1.tooltip: We never saw him. Say that in Ithaca.
source.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.opt.2.label: (Aboard.)
source.dlg.eurylochus.quiet-sail.text: Everybody. Captain — everybody. I have counted twice and it comes out the number we landed with, and I have never in nine years been able to say that on an island. — The cheese is in the hold, the lambs are still up there complaining, and whatever keeps them is going to come home to a house one wheel lighter and never know why.
source.dlg.eurylochus.right-about-it.text: I was right and it cost a man, so let us neither of us make a song of it. — Here is what I will take instead, Captain. Next island, when I say the smoke is wrong, you give me a count of ten before you decide. Ten. That is my whole price.
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.0.label: Who are we? Say it plainly.
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.1.label: Whose island is this?
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.2.label: What's inside?
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.2.tooltip: What did the scouts see inside?
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.text: Captain. Twelve of us on this beach, and I'll say it before you tell me not to: I don't like the look of that smoke. Cheese racked to the roof up there, lambs penned and sorted, the milk pails still warm — and nobody home. Somebody is coming back to that house tonight, and he will not have to hurry.
source.dlg.eurylochus.the-bed.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.the-bed.text: Green branches, laid the way a man lays them for himself. Somebody sleeps in here, Captain, and sleeps easy, on an island with no wall and no dog. Work out what that tells you about him, and then tell me you want to shake his hand.
source.dlg.eurylochus.where.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.where.text: No idea, and that is precisely my objection. We came in through fog — no harbour, no ploughed field, no boundary stone. Nobody has ever cut a furrow here. Whatever keeps these flocks doesn't trade, doesn't sow, and has no neighbours it needs to stay on good terms with.
source.dlg.eurylochus.who.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.eurylochus.who.text: You're Odysseus, son of Laertes, king of Ithaca — and I'm your wife's brother, which is the only reason I'm let to talk to you like this. Troy fell; ten years of it, and the wooden horse at the end was your idea. We've been trying to sail home ever since, and the sea keeps handing us islands instead of Ithaca. That's who we are, Captain. Men who should have been home nine years ago.
source.dlg.perimedes.after-the-eye.opt.0.label: Can he hear us from here?
source.dlg.perimedes.after-the-eye.opt.1.label: (Get high.)
source.dlg.perimedes.after-the-eye.text: It is done. You did it, it is done, do not look at me like that — quiet, quiet — he is up. He is up and he has his hands on the walls. He will find the pens, Captain; he knows this floor blind better than we know it lit. Get high. Get behind the rams and get high.
source.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.opt.0.label: He'll know. He won't know who.
source.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.opt.1.label: Stow the wine.
source.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.opt.1.tooltip: Get the wine-skin back below, lad.
source.dlg.perimedes.all-hands.text: That was fast, Captain. That was — we were in and out and I still have my hands, look. I keep waiting to feel bad about the cheese and it has not come yet. — Do you think he counts them? The wheels, I mean. Do you think he'll know?
source.dlg.perimedes.four-right.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.four-right.text: Four. Then I will stop counting. — I froze when the stone came down, Captain. Eurylochus had me by the collar and my legs would not work, and I have been waiting all night for you to say something about it. You did not. I will remember that longer than I will remember the giant.
source.dlg.perimedes.giant.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.giant.text: One eye, middle of the forehead, and it's the only one he has — I made myself look. His head brushes the roof when he stands. And he talks, Captain, that's the part I wasn't ready for. He talks like a man. He asked us who we were, and he asked politely.
source.dlg.perimedes.he-hears.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.he-hears.text: Everything. He turned on a pebble I kicked. Walk flat-footed, breathe through your mouth, and when he stops moving, you stop moving. That is the whole trick, and I have been practising it for an hour.
source.dlg.perimedes.just-arrived.opt.0.label: Stay at my shoulder.
source.dlg.perimedes.just-arrived.opt.1.label: Watch the mouth for me.
source.dlg.perimedes.just-arrived.text: I am here, Captain, I am here — wine-skin and all, I carried it up myself. — Gods, the smell of it. Milk and smoke and wet wool. Somebody keeps house in here.
source.dlg.perimedes.on-the-sand.opt.0.label: Four is right.
source.dlg.perimedes.on-the-sand.opt.1.label: Get to the oars, lad.
source.dlg.perimedes.on-the-sand.text: We are out. Captain, we are out, we are standing on sand — I had two fists of wool and I have still got the wool, look, it came away in my hands. — Four. I have counted four. Tell me four is right.
source.dlg.perimedes.out.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.out.text: I've walked every wall twice. Pens at the back, his hearth deeper in, and one crack too narrow for a cat. One mouth, one stone. But it opens twice a day, Captain — the flock has to go out to graze and come back. That's all I have for you. That, and he goes down heavy after he's milked. He always sleeps after.
source.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.0.label: Tell me what he is.
source.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.1.label: Is there another way out?
source.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.2.label: We think.
source.dlg.perimedes.root.opt.2.tooltip: Then we don't fight him. We think.
source.dlg.perimedes.root.text: Captain. The stone is down — he rolled it in behind the last ewe the way a man shuts a door, without looking. Twenty-two waggons wouldn't shift it. We're in here with him. And he took Antiphos, picked him up by the ankle. Nine years on the same oar and Antiphos didn't get one word out.
source.dlg.perimedes.stay-close.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.stay-close.text: At your shoulder. Right. — I will not talk. I know I talk. Antiphos says my mouth will get us all killed one day, and he says it like a joke, and I have started to think he means it.
source.dlg.perimedes.to-the-oars.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.to-the-oars.text: Oars. Aye. Something to hold that is not a sheep. — I will pull till my hands come apart, Captain, only let us be past the headland before he thinks to start throwing.
source.dlg.perimedes.under-the-ram.opt.0.label: Where will you be?
source.dlg.perimedes.under-the-ram.text: Under. Get under. — Two fists in the wool at the belly, ankles crossed over its back, and let it walk you out; they are the size of yearling bulls, it will bear you. — Captain. When the light hits your face, do not let go and do not look up at him. Whatever you hear him say, he is saying it to the backs.
source.dlg.perimedes.watch-mouth.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.watch-mouth.text: The mouth. Aye. — It is a big light out there, Captain, and it is getting smaller. I will tell you the moment anything crosses it. I would dearly like to be wrong about that.
source.dlg.perimedes.where-be.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.where-be.text: Third ram from the gate, same as you. If it goes wrong for me you keep going — that is an order from me to you, and I will never get another chance to give you one, so let me have it.
source.dlg.perimedes.wine-below.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.wine-below.text: Below. Aye. — It was for making a stranger a guest, and we never met the stranger, so it goes back in the straw. I would rather carry it up a mountain twice than find out what we were saving it from.
source.dlg.perimedes.wont-know-who.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.perimedes.wont-know-who.text: He'll know and he'll never know who. — Gods, that is a horrible thing to be pleased about, and I am pleased about it. I am going to be pleased about it the whole way home.
source.dlg.polyphemus.flock.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.polyphemus.flock.text: Mine. Every ewe, every ram, every lamb dropped in the spring. I know them by the feel of them, not by counting; I could tell you in the dark which is which, and I do, most nights. You came into my house and ate my cheese. I am not angry about the cheese.
source.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.0.label: Who are you?
source.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.1.label: Whose flock is this?
source.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.2.label: Is there no law here at all?
source.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.3.label: Wine, off my ship.
source.dlg.polyphemus.guest.opt.3.tooltip: I bring wine off my ship. Take it, and be a host to me.
source.dlg.polyphemus.guest.text: You are still awake, little one. Good. There is no savour in a thing that sleeps; it is like bread with no salt. Sit. Talk, if talking is a thing you do. The others did not talk much. Not for long.
source.dlg.polyphemus.law.opt.0.label: A gift instead: wine.
source.dlg.polyphemus.law.opt.0.tooltip: Then take a gift from me instead. Wine, off my ship.
source.dlg.polyphemus.law.opt.1.label: Back.
source.dlg.polyphemus.law.text: Law. I know the word — men carry it in like a smell on their clothes. Zeus is a stranger's god, you'll tell me; a guest is to be fed and gifted and sent on unharmed. But we were here before Zeus, and we are stronger, and I do what I like in my own house. That is the entire law of this island, and I am all of it.
source.dlg.polyphemus.name-boast.opt.0.label: (He is asleep.)
source.dlg.polyphemus.name-boast.text: Odysseus. — Odysseus, sacker of cities. You set it down like a coin you are proud of, and wait to see my face. I have made no face. But I remember everything I am told in my own house; there is little else put in here to remember. Your gift is that I will eat you last. — Ohh. The roof is turning... Stay till morning, sacker of cities.
source.dlg.polyphemus.name-lie.opt.0.label: (He is asleep.)
source.dlg.polyphemus.name-lie.text: Aithon. Out of Crete. — Cretans lie; even here that much is known. But you have given me a name, and a name is what I asked, so I will not quarrel with it. My gift: I will eat Aithon last. — Ohh. The cup, the roof, the... Stay till morning, Cretan.
source.dlg.polyphemus.name-nobody.opt.0.label: (He is asleep.)
source.dlg.polyphemus.name-nobody.text: Nobody. — Nobody. A poor thin name; your parents cannot have loved you much. Then here is your guest-gift, and it is a good one: of all of them, I will eat Nobody last. Last of all. — Ohh. The cup is in the roof, the roof is turning... Stay till morning, Nobody. It has been a long age since anything in here talked back.
source.dlg.polyphemus.self.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.polyphemus.self.text: Polyphemus. My father is Poseidon, who moves under the floor of the sea and shakes it when he is displeased. There is no one on this island but me and the flock — no neighbour I speak to, no one who comes, no one who asks. That is how it has been since before your people thought of boats.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.0.label: Nobody.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.0.tooltip: Nobody. My mother calls me Nobody, my father, my friends — all of them.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.1.label: Odysseus.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.1.tooltip: Odysseus, son of Laertes. Sacker of cities.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.2.label: Aithon.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.opt.2.tooltip: Aithon. A trader, out of Crete.
source.dlg.polyphemus.wine.text: ... What is that. What IS that. We press a wine here from the vine by the pens; it is thin and sour and honest, and I have drunk it every year of my life. This is not that. This is the wine one dreams about. Give me it again. Again. — Ahh. ... Little one. I will do you a kindness in return, for you have done me one, and that is your law, is it not. Tell me your name, and I will give you a guest-gift.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.done.0.arrive.1.narrat: Eurylochus presses himself into the recess beside you, sword drawn and pointless, breathing through his teeth.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.checkpoint.0.respaw: You come to in the east shadow beyond the racks, cold stone at your back, cheese-smell and old smoke in your throat.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.checkpoint.1.narrat: Cheese racked to the roof, lambs penned and sorted by age, the milk pails still warm on the shelf. Whoever keeps this house walked out of it this morning meaning to walk back in tonight.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.checkpoint.5.narrat: Perimedes slips in at your heel with the ship's wine-skin on his shoulder, reads the whole hall once, and puts his back to the recess beside the racks.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.cheese.1.narrate: A wheel of hard yellow cheese, heavy as a shield. Perimedes presses the wine-skin from the ship into your other hand: "Carried it up myself, Captain. In case a stranger needs making a guest."
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.the-argument.2.arri: Perimedes is through the mouth before you finish speaking and down the path ahead of all of you, counting heads onto the sand as they arrive.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.the-argument.3.arri: Antiphos shoulders the sacks without a word and starts down. Arithmetic, Captain: everything you came in with, and one wheel of cheese to the good.
source.fx.cave-of-plenty.oc.the-argument.4.arri: Eurylochus comes down last with the rope still on his shoulder, stands at the gangplank and counts the party aboard one at a time, out loud, twice.
source.fx.follow-the-smoke.oc.reach-mouth.1.nar: The mouth breathes cool air and old smoke. Eurylochus steps inside ahead of you.
source.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.14.seq.10.1.narrat: Stone grinds across the mouth. The daylight narrows to a line, then to nothing.
source.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.14.seq.7.0.narrate: He picks a man up by the ankle without looking, the way a man rights a kicked-over pail. It is Antiphos. No one has time to make a sound.
source.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.15.respawn.6.narra: You come to in the dark of the east alcove, far side of the hall. The giant is a shape at his own fire, milking, unhurried.
source.fx.hide.oc.take-cover.3.narrate: Stay in the shadows and watch. What comes home now was never yours to fight.
source.fx.hide.oc.the-stone.0.narrate: "One eye, middle of the forehead, and he talks like a man — asked us who we were, polite as you like. The stone took twenty-two waggons to set and he rolled it one-handed. We do not fight him, Captain. We think."
source.fx.nobody.done.1.narrate: Perimedes drags a beam of green olive-wood from the giant's stacked timber and puts it in your hands. "Big as a mast, Captain. We cut it down to a point."
source.fx.nobody.oc.the-name.1.narrate: The wine of Maron does its work. His chin sinks to his chest, and the whole cave fills with the long tide of his breathing.
source.fx.shipwrecked.done.0.narrate: Antiphos hoists the wine and the meal-sacks onto one shoulder. "Somebody carries the man's dinner," he says, and falls in behind you. Elpenor stays with the fire — alone, and burning it high.
source.fx.shipwrecked.done.1.arrive.0.narrate: Antiphos sets the sacks down in the light of the mouth and stays there, catching his wind and counting lambs.
source.fx.shipwrecked.oc.climb-out.1.narrate: Eurylochus shoulders a coil of rope and starts up the worn path. Follow the smoke.
source.fx.take-the-cheese.oc.board-flee.0.narra: Oars out, and the strand slides away astern with the lambs still complaining in it. Nobody looks back at the mountain, and nobody has to.
source.fx.take-the-cheese.oc.flee-back.0.narrat: Cheese in the crook of your arm, and behind you the lambs left complaining in their pens. Nobody will ever make a song of this one, Captain. You will simply get home.
source.fx.the-sail.oc.board-nobody.0.narrate: Oars out, and the strand slides away astern. Nobody looks back at the mountain; there is a great deal of open water to be got between you and it before anyone feels like talking.
source.fx.the-sail.oc.last-sand.1.narrate: Behind you, high on the mountain, the blind giant has not gone back inside. He has set himself across the mouth of his own cave with his hands out and his head turned, waiting for a sound to hate. Whatever is still in there is his now.
source.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.10.seq.0.1.narrate: Get up the ramp. Make no sound he can follow.
His head snaps toward you. Freeze — get back into a shadow.
source.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.6.narrate: The hills answer him. His own kind call in at the stone: "Polyphemus! Who is killing you?" And he roars his ruined face against the rock: "NOBODY! Nobody is killing me!" A pause. Then, going away up the mountain: "If nobody hurts you, it is a sickness from Zeus. Pray to your father." And the footsteps do not come back. He hears them go.
source.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.7.narrate: The hills answer him. His own kind call in: "Polyphemus! Who has done this?" And he roars back the name you laid down over the wine, whole and proud: "ODYSSEUS! Sacker of cities, son of Laertes, of Ithaca — he was under my roof!" And they believe him. "Hold, cousin — we cannot shift your stone from without. Wait for the light; at dawn every hand on the mountain opens it together." Perimedes has your sleeve: "They come back at dawn, Captain. We leave before they do."
source.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.8.narrate: The hills answer him. His own kind call in: "Polyphemus! Who has done this?" And he roars back the name you gave him over the wine: "AITHON! A Cretan, out of Crete — at my own fire!" A silence. Then, cool and turning away: "A Cretan. Cousin, the Cretans lie; it is the one thing known of them. Sleep it off." And the footsteps go, half-convinced of nothing, and do not come back tonight.
source.fx.the-stake.oc.blind.9.respawn.4.narrat: You come to in the east alcove, out of the firelight. The blind giant is still pacing the cavern floor, hands out, listening.
source.fx.the-stake.oc.climb-to-pen.2.narrate: The rams crowd the upper pen, warm and stupid and enormous. Below you the giant paces the floor he can no longer see.
source.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.3.narrate: Open water on every side, and the oars finding their stroke. Somewhere behind the dark the island is still there, and it is already somebody else's problem.
source.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.5.seq.1.1.narrat: You won the cave. He will tell the story to the end of his days and never once get the name right, and the neighbours who came as far as the stone have gone back to their own fires believing a sickness took him. No song, no herald, no one ashore who will ever hear it. You will live on that. You will have to.
source.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.5.seq.1.2.narrat: You won the cave, and then you signed it. Somewhere astern the mountain is awake — hands on the slope, cousin calling to cousin, every one of them coming at first light to lift the stone off a man who can now give the sea your name and your father's. Eurylochus has the stroke going and will not look back. Whatever you bought in there, the water will come to collect.
source.fx.the-voyage.oc.aboard.5.seq.1.3.narrat: You won the cave, and a Cretan took the credit. The hills heard the name, weighed it and went back to sleep — a trader out of Crete, and Cretans lie, so nothing worth waking for was said at all. No one is coming for Aithon; there was never an Aithon to come for. You have your crew, your water and a clean horizon, and the best hour of your life belongs to a man who does not exist.
source.fx.trig.boulder-wont-move.0.narrate: You set your shoulder to the great stone. It does not so much as grind. No blade you carry will bite it — whatever opens this cave, it will not be you.
source.fx.trig.he-holds-the-mouth.1.narrate: Your foot turns a pebble in the mouth of the cave and his head comes round on the sound like a door slamming. He told the hills he would eat you last. He did not say he had stopped.
source.fx.trig.his-house.0.narrate: Your blade turns on his hide like a stick on a ship's keel. He sets down the pail. Slowly. In his own house, under his own stone, you have raised a hand to him — and he rises to answer it in full.
source.fx.trig.wake-the-giant.1.narrate: Never strike a sleeping god's son. He comes up off the floor with his whole strength, and there is nothing in this cave that can stand against that.
source.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.1.3: He settles himself against the rock beside the gap and puts his hands out over it, running them along every back that passes. Only the backs. He never thinks to feel underneath.

source.obj.cave-of-plenty.checkpoint.hint: Move in past the mouth to the first broad shelf of the hall, where the racks begin.
source.obj.cave-of-plenty.checkpoint.title: Step Into the Cave
source.obj.cave-of-plenty.cheese.hint: The cheese is racked on the shelves by the entry. Take a wheel from the barrel among them.
source.obj.cave-of-plenty.cheese.title: Take a Wheel of Cheese
source.obj.cave-of-plenty.the-argument.hint: He is at your shoulder by the cheese racks. Tell him whether you run for the ship or wait for the owner of this cave.
source.obj.cave-of-plenty.the-argument.title: Decide With Eurylochus
source.obj.follow-the-smoke.reach-mouth.hint: Climb up off the sand behind him: through the grazing meadow, past the low stone sheep-fold standing walled and empty, and up the switchbacks of the mountain's face to the smoking cave mouth where the great boulder rests.
source.obj.follow-the-smoke.reach-mouth.title: Follow Eurylochus to the Cave
source.obj.hide.take-cover.hint: The light is going and something is coming up the slope. Press into one of the dark recesses along the hall wall, and watch.
source.obj.hide.take-cover.title: Get Into the Shadows
source.obj.hide.the-stone.hint: When the stone is down and the giant sits to his milking, find Perimedes pressed into the recess beside the racks and learn what walked in.
source.obj.hide.the-stone.title: Find Perimedes in the Dark
source.obj.nobody.the-name.hint: Polyphemus sits at the great fire at the heart of the hall. Go to him before you touch anything else of his, and mind your manners about the wine.
source.obj.nobody.the-name.title: Meet the Owner of the Cave
source.obj.shipwrecked.climb-out.hint: He is still at the fire, watching the smoke on the mountain. Give him the word to lead on.
source.obj.shipwrecked.climb-out.title: Tell Eurylochus You Will Climb
source.obj.take-the-cheese.board-flee.hint: Cross the gangplank and take your place at the oars while the cave is still empty behind you.
source.obj.take-the-cheese.board-flee.title: Board the Galley
source.obj.take-the-cheese.flee-back.hint: Back down the mountain the way you climbed, past the fold and the fire, to the gangplank where the galley waits.
source.obj.take-the-cheese.flee-back.title: Run for the Ship
source.obj.the-sail.board-nobody.hint: Cross the gangplank to the deck and take your place. However you leave him, the water is listening.
source.obj.the-sail.board-nobody.title: Board and Give Way
source.obj.the-sail.last-sand.hint: Come down off the mountain to the strand where the galley rides at her gangplank, oars manned and waiting.
source.obj.the-sail.last-sand.title: Down to the Ship
source.obj.the-stake.blind.hint: He is down where the wine took him, at his own fire. Set the hardened point to the single eye and lean your whole weight on it.
source.obj.the-stake.blind.missing_item_hint: You lay a hand on the great closed lid. It is warm, and it moves. The giant talks up out of the wine without waking: "...mm. Not yet. The black one is still to milk..." — and your hand, which is only a hand, comes away.
source.obj.the-stake.blind.title: Put Out the Eye
source.obj.the-stake.climb-to-pen.hint: Leave him roaring at the floor and slip from shadow to shadow up the rock ramp toward the upper sheep-pen. Do not run and do not jump; he hunts by sound now.
source.obj.the-stake.climb-to-pen.title: Climb Toward the Pen
source.obj.the-stake.grind.hint: The giant keeps a grinding stone under the light-shaft on the west floor. Turn the olive beam against it until it takes an edge.
source.obj.the-stake.grind.missing_item_hint: The wheel turns under your palm, takes a slow full circle and bites on nothing at all.
source.obj.the-stake.grind.title: Grind the Point
source.obj.the-stake.harden.hint: Take the sharpened stake to the great walled hearth at the heart of the hall and turn the point in the coals until it blackens hard.
source.obj.the-stake.harden.title: Char It in the Fire
source.obj.the-voyage.aboard.hint: The island is astern and going. Find your bench and let the water do the rest.
source.obj.the-voyage.aboard.title: Take Your Place at the Oar
source.obj.under-the-rams.under-ram.hint: Take two fistfuls of fleece at the belly of the biggest ram and let it carry you, close and quiet, when the flock goes out.
source.obj.under-the-rams.under-ram.title: Get Under a Ram
source.quest.cave-of-plenty.goal: Inside the cave of racked cheese and penned lambs, take a wheel of kefalotyri, and decide with Eurylochus: carry off what you can and run for the ship, or wait to meet the owner of this cave.
source.quest.follow-the-smoke.goal: Follow Eurylochus up off the sand, past the empty sheep-fold in the meadow, to the cave mouth in the mountain's face where the thread of smoke rises.
source.quest.hide.goal: Night, and the owner comes home. Get into the shadow of the alcoves and stay hidden while Polyphemus herds his flock in, seals the mouth with a stone no man can shift, and takes the first of you.
source.quest.nobody.goal: Sealed in with the giant, offer him the strong wine at his own fire, take the name he offers in return, and give him one back that will cost him nothing to curse.
source.quest.shipwrecked.goal: Wake on the strand below the smoking mountain, take up a class and kit at the driftwood fire, drive off the drowned that stumble out of the surf, and hear Eurylochus out before you climb.
source.quest.take-the-cheese.goal: You chose the sea. Slip back down the mountain before the light fails and board the galley at the gangplank while the cave is still empty behind you.
source.quest.the-sail.goal: Board the galley and put the island under your stern. However you leave it, the sea remembers what was said on it.
source.quest.the-stake.goal: While he sleeps, grind the olive stake to a point on his own stone, char it hard in the fire, and put out the single eye. Then follow him blind up the ramp toward the pen without giving him a sound to hunt.
source.quest.the-voyage.goal: Stand on the deck with the island already gone behind you, and hear what the story you leave behind is going to be.
source.quest.under-the-rams.goal: He is blind and listening at the mouth. Get in among the rams of the upper pen and let the flock carry you down and out, back to the gangplank and the waiting oars.
source.world.boundary.message: The surf drags at your legs and hauls you back toward the sand.
source.world.title: Nobody's Isle
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.3.label: Lead on.
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.3.tooltip: Lead on, then. Up to the smoke.
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.4.label: That cheese.
source.dlg.eurylochus.root.opt.4.tooltip: About that cheese in your arms.
source.cast.cave-of-plenty.eurylochus.2.bark.0: Weigh one wheel in your hand, Captain. Then tell me to my face that we stay.
source.cast.cave-of-plenty.eurylochus.2.bark.1: Twelve men eat for a week off one shelf of this. And he will never miss it.
source.cast.cave-of-plenty.eurylochus.2.bark.2: The milk pails are warm. Warm, Captain. Count what that means in strides.
source.cast.hide.perimedes.2.bark.0: (a whisper) He counts them in, Captain. Watch — he touches every fleece as they pass.
source.cast.hide.perimedes.2.bark.1: (a whisper) Every step he takes, I am keeping. Someone will want to know how this was done.
source.cast.hide.perimedes.2.bark.2: (a whisper) When the stone comes down, hold still through the dark of it. Then we talk.
source.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.0.5: Stone grinds back off the mouth — and there is no daylight behind it. A blind man cannot tell noon from midnight, and he has opened his house onto a black sky with the sea standing on end under it.
source.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.7.0: Salt air, and no light in it at all. Somewhere under the noise a very old voice is being told what was done to its son, and the water starts to come in wrong.

source.obj.the-quiet-voyage.out-to-sea.title: Take Your Place at the Oar
source.obj.the-quiet-voyage.out-to-sea.hint: The island is astern and going. Find your bench and let the water do the rest.
Ithaca inside the month. Safe, and fed, and a little smaller for it — and every man you came in with still at his oar.
source.fx.the-quiet-voyage.oc.out-to-sea.4.narr: Open water on every side, and the oars finding their stroke. Behind you the island keeps its giant, its cheese, and its story — short one wheel, and none the wiser.
source.quest.the-quiet-voyage.goal: You chose the sea and the sea took you: stand out from the island with every man you came with, and hear what the quiet costs.
source.fx.the-sail.oc.last-sand.3.narrate: The gangplank is ten strides off, and the sea grudges you every one of them: the shallows give up their dead at your back.
source.fx.under-the-rams.oc.under-ram.1.seq.7.3: Do not stop to fight them. Nothing on this island is worth one more man. Get down the mountain and get to the oars.
